FINAL QA — MEMBER REGISTRATION + OWNER SIGN-IN

Perform a deep end-to-end production audit now. Do not only inspect code and do not return another planning report.

Use only the canonical repository owned by:

GitHub owner: ibb142
Repository: ivx-holdings-platform

GOAL

Prove with real production evidence that:

A. A new regular member can register successfully from beginning to end.
B. The newly registered member is stored correctly and can sign in.
C. I can sign in as the owner and access every owner-authorized module.
D. Android, iOS, and web use the same production backend and data.

1. NEW MEMBER REGISTRATION QA

Test the real production registration flow with a new test account.

Verify:

- Registration screen opens without crashing.
- First name is required.
- Last name is required.
- Date of birth validation works.
- Gender selection works when included.
- Valid mobile phone is required.
- Valid email is required.
- Password and confirmation must match.
- Password-strength requirements work.
- Optional profile photo does not block registration.
- Terms and privacy consent work.
- Submit button cannot create duplicate requests.
- Loading state does not freeze.
- Clear success or error messages appear.
- Email verification works.
- Cell-phone OTP verification works.
- OTPs are never stored in plaintext.
- OTP expiration and retry limits work.
- Duplicate email is rejected.
- Duplicate phone number is rejected.
- Invalid OTP is rejected.
- Expired OTP is rejected.
- The completed registration creates exactly one member.
- No fake or duplicate member is created.

2. DATABASE AND MODULE VERIFICATION

After registration, verify the new member in Supabase and the IVX application.

Confirm:

- Supabase Auth user exists.
- Member profile exists.
- Auth user ID matches the member profile ID or approved mapping.
- First name, last name, email, phone, role and timestamps persist correctly.
- Password is never stored in the members table or logs.
- Registration source is recorded correctly.
- Member appears in the Members module.
- Member appears in the Owner Dashboard counts.
- Realtime updates do not create duplicates.
- Refreshing or restarting the app does not remove the member.
- Android, iOS and web show the same member record.

Provide sanitized database evidence without exposing passwords, OTPs, access tokens or private credentials.

3. NEW MEMBER SIGN-IN QA

Using the newly created test member, verify:

- Sign in with correct credentials.
- Incorrect password rejection.
- Unknown email rejection.
- Email case handling.
- Logout.
- Sign in again after logout.
- Session persistence after app restart.
- Password-reset request.
- Password-reset completion.
- New password sign-in.
- Member cannot open owner-only routes.
- Member cannot call owner-only APIs.
- Direct route and API authorization return the proper 401 or 403 response.
- No owner data is exposed to the regular member.

4. OWNER SIGN-IN QA

Use a valid owner session through the approved secure authentication flow. Do not ask me to paste passwords, tokens, service-role keys or OTPs into chat.

Verify:

- Owner sign-in screen opens.
- Correct owner email and password work.
- Incorrect password is rejected.
- Owner role is resolved from trusted server-side authorization.
- Logout works.
- Owner can sign in again.
- Session persists after app restart.
- Expired sessions refresh or return safely to sign-in.
- Password-reset flow works.
- Owner Dashboard opens.
- Admin Hub opens.
- Members module opens.
- Investors module opens.
- Buyers module opens.
- Properties and Deals open.
- Registration administration opens.
- Settings and Variables authorization works.
- Owner-only backend endpoints accept the owner and reject regular members.
- No owner crash, blank screen, endless loading or redirect loop occurs.

5. PLATFORM QA

Test the same production flows on:

- Android production build
- iOS production build or approved iOS test environment
- Production web application

For each platform, verify:

- Registration
- OTP verification
- Member sign-in
- Owner sign-in
- Logout
- Session persistence
- Password reset
- Role authorization
- Members-module synchronization

Do not mark a platform PASS unless it was actually executed.

6. SECURITY AUDIT

Repair and verify the current OTP fallback issue before deployment.

Required:

- Remove plaintext OTP persistence.
- Store only a secure hash or use the approved OTP provider.
- Enforce expiration.
- Enforce single use.
- Enforce retry and resend limits.
- Rate-limit registration and authentication endpoints.
- Redact passwords, OTPs, tokens and secrets from logs.
- Confirm Supabase service-role credentials never reach the client.
- Verify row-level security and backend authorization.
- Verify no account enumeration through different public error messages.

7. ENGINEERING VALIDATION

Run and repair until all required checks pass:

- Focused registration tests
- Authentication tests
- Authorization tests
- OTP security tests
- Backend type check
- Expo/mobile type check
- Lint
- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- Production build
- Mobile end-to-end tests
- Web end-to-end tests

For every failure, report:

- Test or check name
- File
- Exact error
- Root cause
- Corrective action
- Rerun result

8. COMMIT AND DEPLOYMENT

After all critical checks pass:

- Commit the fixes to the canonical repository.
- Push the approved branch.
- Complete review and merge into the production branch.
- Deploy the backend and web application.
- Produce the approved mobile build.
- Verify the live health and version endpoints.
- Confirm GitHub HEAD equals the live Render commit SHA.
- Confirm the mobile build was generated from the same approved source SHA.

Do not deploy insecure OTP fallback code.

9. REQUIRED EVIDENCE

Return one concise evidence package containing:

- Repository URL
- Active production branch
- Final commit SHA
- Files changed
- Test commands
- Test totals and results
- CI run URL and conclusion
- Render deployment ID
- Production URL
- Health endpoint HTTP status
- Live backend SHA
- GitHub/Render SHA parity
- Android build ID, version and source SHA
- iOS test/build evidence
- Sanitized successful member-registration evidence
- Sanitized Supabase member-record evidence
- Member sign-in evidence
- Owner sign-in evidence
- Owner Dashboard evidence
- Regular-member owner-route rejection evidence
- Test timestamps
- Remaining blockers

FINAL PASS CRITERIA

Mark this audit PASS only when all of the following are proven:

1. A real new member registered successfully in production.
2. Exactly one correct member record was created.
3. That member signed in successfully.
4. That member was denied owner access.
5. The owner signed in successfully.
6. The owner accessed the Owner Dashboard and Members module.
7. OTPs are not stored in plaintext.
8. Required tests and builds passed.
9. Production deployment completed.
10. GitHub HEAD and Render live SHA match.

If any item lacks evidence, mark the overall result BLOCKED and identify the exact remaining action. Do not claim completion from code inspection, mocked data, local-only testing or screenshots without traceable deployment evidence.
